intuition: Keep tracked half-open intervals disjoint and sorted so updates can merge, split, or preserve only affected segments.

brute_force.approach: Represent every integer point in a large bitmap and inspect each point in every operation.
brute_force.time: addRange O(U), queryRange O(U), removeRange O(U)

optimal.approach: Maintain sorted disjoint intervals; merge overlaps on addition, check coverage on query, and split overlaps on removal.
optimal.time: addRange O(n), queryRange O(n), removeRange O(n)

edge_cases: All ranges are half-open, so the right endpoint is excluded.
Removing a middle section can leave two tracked pieces.
